payload.title: Replace Classifiers navigation with Scorecards and nested classifier editors
payload.description: Top-level navigation: Scorecards, Item lists, Optimizations. Scorecards list shows names, active revisions and classifier membership; scorecard detail lists ordered classifiers and opens their configuration/history. Support creating a scorecard, adding an existing classifier or a new classifier, binary/multiclass classes with configurable order and positive/negative roles, editing as a new revision and explicit version activation. Show impact of classifier edits on affected scorecard versions and joint requests. Keep existing session/run selection in deep links; do not accidentally start paid runs on navigation. Save/Cancel must remain reachable in a bounded editor footer with scrollable form body at narrow/iPad viewports. Acceptance: browser and component tests navigate, edit Knowledge Bases, save a new version, inspect old versions, and retain in-progress label drafts when opening/closing navigation.
